description: This file defines a React functional component named Navbar that renders the application's navigation bar. It includes links to various sections for authenticated users, handles user logout via dataService, and manages navigation states.

methods.name: Navbar({ user })
methods.description: React functional component rendering the navigation bar, accepting 'user' as a prop to determine whether to show navigation links and user controls.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Async function triggered on 'Log out' button click; calls the dataService logout method and redirects to the login page.
